name: Guneku Agro Common Initiative Group

phase2.note: Final opportunity to join at current pricing

registration.issuingAuthority: Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Development (MINADER), Regional Delegation North West, Regional Service of the Registry (COOP/CIG)
registration.legalBasis: Law No. 92/006 of 14 August 1992 on cooperative societies and common initiative groups, and application decree No. 92/455/PM of 23 November 1992
registration.certificateNumberNote: The certificate number was read by OCR and has not yet been checked digit by digit against the original. It is therefore not published, and the certificate image is not published either. Both are held pending visual verification.
registration.evidence: Official registration certificate supplied by Marcel, 2026-09-01; the administrative detail above was extracted from that certificate. Identifiers are deliberately withheld until verified.

programme: Arrival of the population and guest dance groups
Welcome speech by the Fon of Guneku and village authorities
Animations by the Guneku Kwem Dance Group, the Mbemi Mukonge Dance Group and the Nkem Dance Group
Speech by the VDO and vision bearers
Traditional rites performed by the fathers and the Palace at Ngong
Presentation of the benefits of the CIG to the Meta community by the Secretary General
General announcements by Fah Elvis Tayong
Closing remarks by the Vice Delegate

communiques.effect: Registration fee of 5,000 FCFA extended to 30 April 2026 after members asked for relief.
From 3 May 2026 registration moved to 15,000 FCFA; share price unchanged at 2,000 FCFA.

milestones: Tender issued to construct the giant poultry house, 18 April 2026
Campaign milestone announced publicly: Operation 20 million FCFA by 30 April 2026
Campaign milestone announced publicly: Operation 5 million plus by 20 June 2026

staffMeeting.attendees: The Executive, the Home-based CIG Exco, the Manager and the site staff.
staffMeeting.note: Convened by the Delegate on 28 August 2026 for the executive and all staff at the main site. No attendance list is recorded.

paymentRoute: Payments and share purchases run through GUNECCUL, the community credit union.

membershipPricing.note: The full documented pricing record, in the order it was issued. Where the announcements differ, both are shown with their dates rather than one being chosen. Confirmation of the current line is with Fah Elvis Tayong, CIG Delegate.

timeline.detail: Registration at 5,000 FCFA extended to 30 April 2026 after members asked for relief.
Announced a Phase 3 beginning 1 May 2026 with the share price rising to 5,000 FCFA as the business became fully operational.

From 3 May 2026 registration moved to 15,000 FCFA and the share price was kept at 2,000 FCFA. This is the most recent pricing communique in the record; the 5,000 FCFA share price announced on 4 April does not appear in it.

membershipPricing.paymentRoute: Payments and share purchases run through GUNECCUL, the Guneku community credit union, account number 200637.
membershipPricing.confirmation: Fah Elvis Tayong, CIG Delegate, to confirm which line is current.

governance.note: How the CIG is run, as its own communiques and notices establish it. Offices are listed because the record names the offices; where the record does not name the holder, none is supplied.

offices.note: Signs the CIG communiques and convenes its meetings. The same man the Palace record names as Ngam-Fon and the GUDECA roster names as National Publicity Secretary — one man in three roles, not three men.
Recorded in the launch programme of 5 April 2026, which gives the closing remarks to the Vice Delegate. The holder is not named in the record.
Presented the benefits of the CIG to the Meta community at the launch. The holder is not named in the record.
Runs the main site and its staff. The holder is not named in the record.

bodies.name: Management Board
bodies.note: Issues the registration and share communiques, and is named as their author from the communique of 2 May 2026 onward.

bodies.name: Executive body
bodies.note: Named as the body that extended the 5,000 FCFA registration fee in April 2026.

bodies.name: Home-based CIG Exco
bodies.note: The executive at home in Guneku, convened with the staff at the main site. No roster is recorded and none is invented.

governance.rosterNote: No membership list, share register or staff list is published here. The CIG holds those; this record holds what the CIG itself announced publicly.

commercialActivity.note: Trading the CIG has announced publicly. Each line is an announcement on its date, not a statement of the enterprise’s present position.

recorded.activity: First poultry sale announced — the three-week-old chickens sold.
Share upgrading opened to 15 June 2026, with registration continuing for new members.
Executive and staff meeting held at the main site.

milestonesNote: These are campaign announcements on the dates they were made — what the CIG asked its members to aim at. None of them is a balance, a total raised or an achieved figure, and no financial position of the CIG is published here.
